text:
Nikhil: flagging an oddness: consent flags from the new marketing connector aren't always propagating to the CRM contact rows. some accounts show contact.opt_in_status = NULL while the source connector has opt_in=true. affects playbook triggers and healthscore (we're overweighting engagement).
Bea: that's worrying. how many accounts impacted? any quick detection query?
Nikhil: ran a sample: SELECT c.contact_id FROM contacts c JOIN connector_payload p ON c.external_id=p.external_id WHERE p.opt_in = true AND c.opt_in_status IS NULL LIMIT 100; returned 82 in the last 7d.
Carmen: if playbooks assume opt_in==true for nudges, we could accidentally send renewal outreach to contacts who never consented. we need a safe stop-gap: prevent playbooks that send external comms from firing when contact.opt_in_status IS NULL.
Bea: agree. propose a playbook guard rule: treat NULL as "unknown" and route to an internal workflow rather than external nudges. also schedule a backfill to populate opt_in_status from connector_payload.source_ts, but only in idempotent batches.
Nikhil: here's a draft detection SQL and a playbook dry-run. detection:```sql
-- find contacts with missing opt_in but recent connector=true
SELECT account_id, count(*) as missing_contacts
FROM contacts c
JOIN connector_payload p ON c.external_id = p.external_id
WHERE p.opt_in = true
  AND c.opt_in_status IS NULL
  AND p.source_ts > now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY missing_contacts DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Bea: playbook snippet (dry-run):```yaml
- name: consent-propagation-guard
  trigger: contact.opt_in_status == null && connector_payload.opt_in == true
  actions:
    - tag: consent:needs-review
    - route: cs-internal-review
    - block_external_comms: true
  mode: dry_run
```
PlaybookBot: scheduled dry-run for "consent-propagation-guard" against 14d of connector data at 2026-05-12T14:00Z. estimated affected accounts: 82. Report will be posted in #customer-success in 4m.
OpsBot: pausing outbound playbooks that send external emails for accounts with tag "consent:needs-review" until further notice.
Carmen: next steps: 1) run dry-run and review matches, 2) backfill opt_in_status in safe batches (idempotent), 3) re-evaluate healthscore weights for accounts with recent consent fixes so renewal signals aren't noisy.
Bea: I'll own the backfill plan and add a TTL-based circuit breaker (stop after 5000 contacts or 10 errors). Nikhil can you prepare the backfill SQL and a small test on staging?
Nikhil: yes. backfill plan sketch:```sql
-- idempotent upsert: set opt_in_status only when null
WITH src AS (
  SELECT c.contact_id, p.opt_in, p.source_ts
  FROM contacts c
  JOIN connector_payload p ON c.external_id = p.external_id
  WHERE p.opt_in = true
    AND c.opt_in_status IS NULL
    AND p.source_ts > now() - interval '30 days'
  LIMIT 1000
)
UPDATE contacts
SET opt_in_status = 'opted_in', opt_in_source = 'connector', opt_in_updated_at = now()
FROM src
WHERE contacts.contact_id = src.contact_id
RETURNING contacts.contact_id;
```
Carmen: once backfill runs, we should recalc healthscore for affected accounts with a small batch job (healthscore-v2.recompute(account_ids)). don't run full recalcs — just the accounts returned by the detection query.
Bea: I'll add the circuit breaker and error monitoring. Also drafting a CSM note template to surface the automation to account owners before we flip any outbound playbooks on.
Nikhil: draft note: "Heads up: we detected missing consent metadata for some contacts coming from a connector. We're reconciling records and will suppress external nudges for affected accounts until validated. No action required unless you see unexpected outreach"
Carmen: good. assigning: Bea -> backfill plan + circuit breaker + CSM note; Nikhil -> staging test + detection query + run backfill dry-run; PlaybookBot -> run dry-run and post report; OpsBot -> prevent external playbooks from targeting tagged accounts.
PlaybookBot: dry-run complete. matches: 82 accounts, sample account_ids: [acct_0x3f1, acct_0x8a7, acct_0x4c9]. Full CSV uploaded to /internal/cs/reports/consent-propagation-2026-05-12.csv.
Bea: starting dry-run backfill in staging now. will report results and errors here.
Nikhil: staging backfill succeeded for sample batch of 50. opt_in_status set for 49 (1 had conflicting historical value). logging audit events for each update.
Carmen: looks good. once Bea confirms production guard configs, we'll flip to block_external_comms=true and run prod backfill in limited batches. thanks team.
Bea: will post prod schedule and monitor metrics (outbound sends suppressed, healthscore drift) here.
Nikhil: closing loop after prod run. will ping when done.
